Leah (CEO): Short live-thread to lock down follow-ups from today's Q&A about customer wins/losses. Please post one signal or action per reply.

Noah (Revenue Ops): Sales reports two consistent loss themes: 1) missing customer-managed key support, 2) procurement pushback on retention and incident response timelines.

Gina (Product Marketing): For wins we should capture 2 short case blurbs: retail migration and adtech latency win. Can we get numbers?

Omar (Customer Success): Retail migration: reported ~35% token cost savings after we enabled prefix caching + optimized batching settings. Adtech: saw p95 drop from 420ms -> 220ms after route pinning and model quantization.

Keiko (Eng): Engineering follow-ups: Need to scope BYOK (HSM vs KMS) and retention. Also propose a standard "migration checklist" artifact we can add to the docs site.

Leah (CEO): Owners: Keiko to scope BYOK, Omar + Gina to draft two customer blurbs, Noah to compile procurement redlines. Team: aim for drafts in 5 business days.

ticket-bot: Created ticket: DOCS-782 "Migration checklist + customer blurbs" assigned to Omar. Link: https://redwood.internal/docs/DOCS-782

Omar (Customer Success): Will start Doc draft and request anonymized metrics from the customers.

Leah (CEO): Thanks all. Put anything else here and we'll close once the ticket is populated. :spiral_calendar:
